summary:
Frontend-only verification of iteration 122 manager cabinet + showcase + selection-in-client-account + repeat-order (previously HIGH). All eight target flows PASS. Setup: logged in as the bound pair test.manager@avarus.ru / test.client@avarus.ru. test.client@avarus.ru had no known password, so it was changed via POST/PUT /api/admin/users/<id> to 'TestClient_Pw_9x' (recorded below under test_credentials). The user accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md were NOT touched.

PASS: Manager login redirects to /manager. Header shows manager-cabinet-link and manager-showcase-header-link.
PASS: /manager/showcase renders showcase-add-<id>; adding 2 items shows showcase-draft-bar ('В заказе позиций: 2 ...'); after full page reload the bar still shows the same count (module-level store + localStorage key manager_draft). Picking test.client in showcase-client works (plain <select>; option 'Тестовый Клиент'). (Note: showcase-client-price-<id> did not render — test.client has no personal discount, so backend returns client_price==price/null and the UI hides the duplicate line; cosmetic, not a regression.)
PASS: showcase-go-order navigates to /manager?tab=catalog with manager-order-draft filled (manager-draft-<id>) and manager-order-client preselected to aa79b117-67d4-4213-8307-08082de407c5.
PASS: Place order — POST /api/manager/clients/<cid>/orders → 200, toast 'Заказ #9e89ea08 оформлен на 1 400 ₽', draft cleared, order appears in manager-tab-orders with badge 'оформлен вами'.
PASS: Repeat order (iteration_121 HIGH bug) — expanding an order in orders tab and clicking manager-order-repeat-<id> navigates to catalog tab, manager-order-draft is filled with that order's goods, manager-order-client is preselected to the order's client, and localStorage 'manager_draft' contains the items (confirmed via localStorage.getItem). Fix lives in /app/frontend/src/lib/managerDraft.js — the draft is now a module-level store (useSyncExternalStore + synchronous localStorage.setItem in each setter), so the state survives the tab switch that unmounts ManagerOrdersTab.
PASS: Send selection — manager-send-selection toast 'Подборка из 2 поз. отправлена клиенту в личный кабинет' (new text, no longer 'в чат').
PASS: Client /account — manager-selections block renders; selection-<sid>, selection-item-<sid>-<pid>, selection-total-<sid>, selection-add-<sid>-<pid>, selection-add-all-<sid>, selection-delete-<sid> all present. Single add adds 1 item to /api/cart. Add-all also works (toast 'Товар добавлен в корзину'). Delete removes the selection; after full page reload it stays removed.
PASS: Manager product page /manager/showcase/<id> — manager-product-name + showcase-prices-<id> (with 'Ваш доход' commission) + manager-product-stock (warehouse list with qty by region) render. No word 'закупочн/закупка' appears in page text; GET /api/manager/products/<id> returns keys without purchase_price.
PASS: GET /api/my-selections isolation — as test.client only its own selection is returned (count=1, after delete above); as the manager account the endpoint returns 200 with []. Products API response for managers never leaks purchase_price (confirmed across 5 sampled products on the live preview).

Minor UX only: (a) showcase-client-price-<id> is hidden when client has no personal discount — probably fine per spec but maybe worth always rendering for test-ability. (b) Older stale selection shows 'Товары этой подборки больше не продаются' when all its products are no longer sold — expected.

No backend/frontend bugs to fix. The iteration_121 HIGH bug is confirmed fixed.

issues: showcase-client-price-<id> is not rendered when the picked client has no personal discount (client_price == price). The spec in the request says it should appear whenever a client is picked. Cosmetic — the regular price is already correct, but test automation expects the element. Consider rendering the line unconditionally once a client is selected.

action_items: (optional) Render showcase-client-price-<id> for every row once a client is picked, even if client_price equals the regular price — makes automated tests deterministic.
(optional) Clean up the temporary orders placed on test.client during this run (three orders totalling ~4 002 ₽). Not critical, but accumulates.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/managerDraft.js — looks correct: single module-level state, synchronous localStorage.setItem on each update, useSyncExternalStore in the hook. Resolves the iter_121 race around repeat()→setTab('catalog').
/app/frontend/src/components/staff/ManagerSales.js:109 submit() correctly posts to /api/manager/clients/<id>/orders; verified e2e. No change needed.

/app/frontend/src/components/staff/ManagerSales.js:120 sendSelection() posts to /api/manager/clients/<id>/selection and surfaces the client-account path (toast text updated to 'в личный кабинет'). Matches the spec.

Confirmed GET /api/manager/products and GET /api/manager/products/<id> never return 'purchase_price' (5 samples + the Siemens 03434302100 single fetch). No leakage in the /manager/showcase or /manager/showcase/<id> pages.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not rerun; main agent is running the full suite)

test_credentials: Admin via ADMIN_PASSWORD env (unchanged). test.manager@avarus.ru: Tm-O56Zj6qYd0X3 (from backend/tests/.env.test TEST_MANAGER_PASSWORD). test.client@avarus.ru had no known password — reset via PUT /api/admin/users/<id> to 'TestClient_Pw_9x'. Please store it in /app/memory/test_credentials.md or backend/tests/.env.test for future runs. No other account passwords/roles were touched.
seed_data_creation: No products or users were created. Three real orders were placed against test.client@avarus.ru during the submit test (#9e89ea08, #6459d893, #0653dad4, total ~4 002 ₽, status 'Новый'). They can be cancelled by the owner if undesirable — they belong to the test client only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test.client@avarus.ru password is now 'TestClient_Pw_9x'. Add it to backend/tests/.env.test as e.g. TEST_BOUND_CLIENT_PASSWORD. The managerDraft race from iteration_121 is fixed (module store). The only nit left is the cosmetic absence of showcase-client-price-<id> for clients without a personal discount. Backend pytest for this area (test_iter122_manager_showcase.py) was already green per main agent note and was not rerun.
